_conventions: origin on the bank's bulkhead line at the pool (Z 0 = 435.5 ft), +X out over the water, deck tops at Z 1.0 (HouseKit.cpp Zd). Sizes in metres; expect = bounding box x, y (and z where given) the build must hold within tol (5%, the plan's check 1). Piling depth (to Z -2.6) is not part of z.

_rules.rockwall_takeline: Rockwall's Takeline Overlay District (UDC subsection 6, v4.2023, read through search excerpts only: rockwall.com is not reachable from the cloud): a boathouse needs a residential sublease, a seawall and a fixed pier; every stored boat under the roof; one boat lift or two PWC lifts inside; local builders say enclosed or fully decked-in boathouses are not allowed, covered open-sided ones are. A 15 ft / one storey height figure appears in excerpts. Heath's lake-edge ordinance (excerpt): fixed piers and dock decks on metal pilings.
_rules.dallas: Dallas Water Utilities owns the lake and must concur with any construction on the take line. A search summary said Dallas bars boat lifts on its take line; Rockwall's code requires them inside boathouses and the game's own pc/shore-residential pass found lifts common, so lifts stay, and Bean's photo trip settles it.
_rules.unconfirmed: No size cap for piers found. Sizes below are common practice and catalogue sizes, not code limits.

_sources: BH-USA 10,000 lb galvanized four-post pile-mount lift: 10 ft top beams, 12 ft 6 in cradle beams on the 6,000 lb model (bh-usa.com)
EZ Dock EZ Port 260 / 280 drive-on PWC ports: 156 x 60 x 15 in / 156 x 80 x 15 in (ez-dock.com)
deck boards 5/4x6 (140 x 25 mm) with 6 mm gaps; 2x8 rims and joists; 8 5/8 in steel pipe pilings (common Texas lake practice)
R-panel / PBR roofing: major ribs every 12 in (305 mm), 1 1/4 in high
